title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Babson College
description: Build an under-21-safe late-night ritual board. Every card needs a currently verifiable destination, a direct source supporting late availability, and a conservative explanation of why it matters near this campus. Do not invent student habits, signature orders, popularity, or current hours. Bars and 21+-only venues are prohibited.

cards.title: The Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: 21 Babson College Dr
cards.notes: Visit the Global Lounge for late-night study sessions or grab food at the various dining stations located on the first floor.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student life, offering dining, study spaces, and social areas open late for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Reynolds is described as the central hub for late-night cravings and mobile ordering, housing multiple dining options.
cards.access_notes: Dining hours vary by station; the building remains accessible to students via OneCard for study and lounge use.

cards.evidence_claim: Chick-N-Bap is listed as a dining option in Reynolds Campus Center for late-night cravings.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Reynolds Campus Center; check the mobile ordering app for current nightly closing times.
